## Rule

**Horizontal NOR.** Input always 4×7: cols 0-2 = left panel, col 3 = separator (always color 1), cols 4-6 = right panel. Output always 4×3: `out[r,c] = 3 (green) if left[r,c]==0 AND right[r,c]==0 else 0`. Verified 268/268 (train+test+arc-gen). `pred = ((i[:,0:3]==0) & (i[:,4:7]==0)) * 3`.

## Cost analysis

**Current best 200** (memory 0 + params 200), banked task-local at `The_400_Tasks/Task_by_Task/task386/staged_candidates/task386_task026_conv_port_cost200_sha0C31BF76/` (sha256 `0c31bf76…`; builder reproduces byte-identical). Re-verified 2026-07-02 (worker1): visible 268/268, truth 200000/200000, battery PASS (ab byte-equal vs submission.zip, 0 divergences), profile=static=200. Bar 211 (Aditya, team manifest) → **Δ −11 (win)**.
The graph ports task026's single free-output Conv: a 1x2 kernel with dilation 4 reads the left panel cell at col `c` and the corresponding right panel cell at col `c+4`, and writes the 30x30 one-hot output directly. Nonzero weights are only channel-0 black and channel-3 green logits: black = `-left_bg + 0.5*right_bg + 2*right_fg5`; green = `right_bg - left_fg7`. Invalid separator/right-panel columns do not fire because their needed right tap is off-grid or their color is not weighted.

**Sub-200 check:** grouped Conv is blocked by ONNX's contiguous group partitioning. `groups=2/5/10` disconnect either output channel 0 from right foreground color 5, or output channel 3 from left foreground color 7 / background channel 0. A narrow 2- or 4-channel Conv followed by channel Pad charges the Conv result as an intermediate and loses badly to the one-node full-channel Conv. Sparse Conv weights are not scorer-legal for Conv, so the 200 dense kernel is the legal one-node Conv floor found here.
